title: ProST-Annomyze / prostate-deid: De-identification, Image-Preserving Text Removal and MR-Aware Conversion for Prostate MRI
description: ProST-Annomyze (prostate-deid 0.2.1) removes burned-in text while keeping the image (glyph segmentation + inpainting, with verification), converts DICOM / NIfTI / raster inputs with MR-aware tag retention, study-level pseudonyms and preserved geometry and intensities, and composes DICOM tag scrubbing, patient ID/date pseudonymization, burned-in pixel PHI redaction, and prostate zonal/lesion masking into a single Compose-style pipeline that produces one shared, structured audit trail suitable for compliance documentation.
